name: consolation
quote: I lost the match, but her look of pride of helped.
description: Something that adds some relief to a negative situation.

variations.name: thankful consolation
variations.description: May come with gratitude towards someone who provided assistance.

commentaries.quote: A consolation is a small positive amidst a larger negative situation which differs from bittersweet which is a balance of positive and negative.

conditions: Perception of something positive that partially offsets concurrent negatives
